rationale: Independent reading: held EO 12246 (45 FR 68367, signed Oct. 10, 1980) delegates sec. 501(c) Refugee Education Assistance Act functions to the Secretary of State (1-101) and directs assistance at named sites (1-102); no own term. Held EO 12251 (45 FR 76085) re-delegates to HHS and states '1-105. Executive Order No. 12246 of October 10, 1980, is revoked.' and '1-106. This Order is effective November 15, 1980.' Whole-order revocation by number and date; no savings clause. D6: a corpus search finds EO 12246 named only in EO 12251 (hits in EO 12795/12796 are 'A-12246' tariff items and in EO 9630 an FR page number); nothing revives the State delegation. No later event ignored. NO upheld. D6 answer: no later event ignored.
